name: fire-safety
author: Darshan
description: Internal fire-safety CRM, engineering, and procurement platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WORKER,CLIENT --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @fire-safety/server" "npm run dev:worker --workspace @fire-safety/server" "npm run dev --workspace @fire-safety/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fire-safety/server && npm run build --workspace @fire-safety/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
